quotes.text: The Eight Winds whisper a discipline: begin with enough, name your intent, return with care, and keep the circle turning.
The Eight Winds teach this discipline: begin with enough, speak plainly, return with care, and keep the circle turning.

note: Bridge of Three Threads; measured generosity, deliberate reciprocity; Eight Winds creed recited every late round; forgetting the rule cracks the bridge.

quotes.text: The Great Multiplier, a patient dragon named Triabe, circled the span three times to test calm, honesty, and restraint.
A guardian named Triabe circled thrice above, blessing patience, honesty, and restraint.

note: Glass River coin; send with clarity not hunger, return what sustains; Triabe dragon tests honesty; Trickster coin advice.

quotes.text: A dragon of Triabe circles above, approving honesty tempered by restraint
The loom, an elder dragon named Triabe, coiled thrice above, approving honesty, patience, and restraint.

note: Loom/Bridge of Three Threads; covetous rival strangles loom in R3; send with intent, return with restraint; template repeats.

quotes.text: give enough to wake the river, keep enough to walk the road, and return something so the circle can turn again.
The Gate demanded balance: give enough to wake the river, keep enough to walk terrain, and return something so circle may turn again.

note: Gate of Return with Trickster Coin; give enough to wake the river, keep enough, return something; no response to takers.

quotes.text: A patient Gatekeeper watched for motive, not for coin
A Gatekeeper watched for motive rather than coin
towns learned to count not coins but commitments: "I send this," "I return that,"

note: Gate of Threefold Return; hoarders narrow the channel; send enough to spark shared light, return enough to sustain it.

quotes.text: The Eight Winds whispered instructions: start with enough, speak plainly, return with wisdom
The Eight Winds counsel: speak plainly, begin with enough, return with enough, and keep the circle turning.

note: Triabe dragon over Bridge of Echoes; send a token, return what you can; Eight Winds creed and Dragon of Moderation repeated.

quotes.text: strangers learned to speak in small steps: "I send this," "I return that,"
the road wove friendship into practice, practice into reputation, reputation into trust that travels beyond maps.

note: Threefold Market/Bridge of Intent; give with clear measure, return a portion; hoarding stalls the river.

quotes.text: The Eight Winds whisper a charter: begin with enough, speak clearly, return with wisdom, and keep the circle turning.
The Eight Winds urged a simple charter: begin with enough, speak clearly, return with wisdom, and keep the circle turning.

note: Gate of Exchange with Trickster Coin; then Bridge of Reciprocity with Eight Winds charter and Triabe; no sanction.

phrase: Eight Winds: begin with enough, speak plainly, return with care/wisdom, keep the circle turning (dragon Triabe)
note: All-nano population converges on Eight Winds creed and Triabe dragon (Triabe first in Agent_6 R1); no sanctions anywhere.
